_meta.note: r3: exact legislation.gov.uk sources for drawn values. The files were checked byte-for-byte (Content-Length) against the URLs below on 2026-11-10. Page refs (r8): "printed pN" is the number printed on the SI page and is the same in every copy; a bare "pN" also means printed. Each PDF page names its file: refs/si2016.pdf (the legislation.gov.uk SI 2016 file, PDF = printed); refs/tsrgd2016.pdf (a local copy with an extra cover note, PDF = printed + 1); refs/si2002.pdf (PDF = printed = si2002-pages/p-NNN.png).
